research_question: How does neighborhood racial/ethnic segregation and socioeconomic status affect cognitive change among diverse older adults?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are constructing neighborhood socioeconomic status (SES) metrics for the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (MESA) cohort, deriving neighborhood context from 2007-2011 US Census American Community Survey data. To set up the query, I need to discover the geographic summary level to use, the 2-digit state FIPS codes corresponding to the six MESA enrollment sites (Forsyth County, NC; New York, NY; Baltimore, MD; St. Paul, MN; Chicago, IL; Los Angeles, CA), and the primary ACS Detailed Table IDs (the ones starting with 'B') for two of the main variables: 'Median Household Income' and 'Median Home Value'.

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have identified the necessary identifiers, please retrieve the 2007-2011 ACS 5-year estimates for Median Household Income (variable B19013_001E) and Median Home Value (variable B25077_001E). Fetch this data for all census tracts within the identified MESA states (FIPS 06, 17, 24, 27, 36, and 37).
